points.title: 童年富贵
points.description: 曹雪芹出生于南京江宁织造府，其祖父曹寅曾任江宁织造，家族显赫。这一时期，曹雪芹接受了良好的教育，广泛阅读各类书籍，包括诗词、戏曲、小说等。他生活在文学氛围浓厚的环境中，家族藏书丰富，这为他后来的文学创作奠定了坚实基础。然而，这段富贵生活也让他过早地接触到封建社会的种种弊端，为他日后创作《红楼梦》提供了素材和思想基础。
points.descriptionEn: Born in the Jiangning Weaving Mansion in Nanjing, Cao Xueqin came from a prominent family. His grandfather Cao Yin had served as the Director of the Imperial Textile Manufactories in Jiangning. During this period, Cao Xueqin received excellent education and had access to a wide range of books including poetry, drama, and novels. He grew up in a literary environment with a rich family library, which laid a solid foundation for his later literary creations. However, this luxurious life also exposed him to the various shortcomings of feudal society, providing material and ideological basis for his later work 'Dream of the Red Chamber'.

points.title: 家道中落
points.description: 1727年，曹雪芹随家族迁往北京。然而，由于政治原因，曹家逐渐失势，被抄家，家道中落。这一变故对曹雪芹影响巨大，从富贵公子沦为平民。他开始亲身体验社会底层的生活，观察人情冷暖，这些经历成为他日后创作的重要素材。在北京期间，曹雪芹开始接触民间艺术，如评书、戏曲等，进一步丰富了他的文学素养。这段经历也让他对封建社会的虚伪和腐朽有了更深刻的认识。
points.descriptionEn: In 1727, Cao Xueqin moved to Beijing with his family. However, due to political reasons, the Cao family gradually lost favor and was eventually confiscated of their property. This dramatic change had a profound impact on Cao Xueqin, transforming him from a wealthy young man to a commoner. He began to experience life at the bottom of society firsthand, observing the warmth and coldness of human relationships, which became important material for his later works. During his time in Beijing, Cao Xueqin began to contact folk arts such as storytelling and opera, further enriching his literary literacy. This experience also gave him a deeper understanding of the hypocrisy and corruption of feudal society.

points.title: 隐居创作
points.description: 这一时期，曹雪芹移居北京西郊，过着清贫的隐居生活。他靠卖画和亲友接济度日，但精神生活丰富。正是在这一时期，曹雪芹开始构思并创作《红楼梦》的前八十回。他将自己的人生经历和对社会的观察融入创作中，塑造了贾宝玉、林黛玉等经典人物形象。西郊的隐居生活让曹雪芹能够远离尘嚣，专心创作，同时也让他有更多机会接触普通百姓，了解他们的生活状态和思想情感，这些都为他的创作提供了丰富的素材。
points.descriptionEn: During this period, Cao Xueqin moved to the western suburbs of Beijing, living a hermit's life in poverty. He supported himself by selling paintings and receiving help from friends and relatives, but his spiritual life was rich. It was during this time that Cao Xueqin began to conceive and write the first 80 chapters of 'Dream of the Red Chamber'. He incorporated his life experiences and observations of society into his creation, shaping classic characters such as Jia Baoyu and Lin Daiyu. The hermitage life in the western suburbs allowed Cao Xueqin to be away from the hustle and bustle, concentrate on his writing, and also gave him more opportunities to contact ordinary people, understand their living conditions and thoughts and feelings, all of which provided rich material for his creation.

points.title: 创作高峰
points.description: 曹雪芹移居北京西山，继续《红楼梦》的创作。这一时期，他的创作进入高峰期，对人物刻画更加深入，情节更加复杂。曹雪芹在创作中融入了丰富的诗词、戏曲、绘画等多种艺术形式，使《红楼梦》成为中国古典小说的巅峰之作。他还与一些文人墨客交往，如敦敏、敦诚兄弟，这些交往对他的创作产生了积极影响。然而，生活依然贫困，曹雪芹常常需要依靠朋友接济才能维持基本生活，这种困境也反映在《红楼梦》中对贾府衰落的描写中。
points.descriptionEn: Cao Xueqin moved to the Western Hills of Beijing, continuing his work on 'Dream of the Red Chamber'. During this period, his creation entered a peak phase, with more in-depth character portrayals and more complex plots. Cao Xueqin incorporated various art forms such as poetry, drama, and painting into his creation, making 'Dream of the Red Chamber' a masterpiece of Chinese classical fiction. He also interacted with some literati such as the Dun brothers, which had a positive impact on his creation. However, life was still difficult, and Cao Xueqin often needed to rely on friends for support to maintain a basic living, which is reflected in the description of the decline of the Jia family in 'Dream of the Red Chamber'.

points.title: 晚年与未竟之作
points.description: 晚年，曹雪芹回到北京，继续修改和完善《红楼梦》。然而，由于生活贫困和健康状况恶化，他未能完成这部巨著的后四十回。据传，曹雪芹在临终前将手稿托付给友人，但这些手稿后来散失。曹雪芹的去世使《红楼梦》成为一部未完成的作品，这也成为中国文学史上的一大遗憾。尽管如此，《红楼梦》的前八十回已经展现出了极高的文学价值，成为中国古典小说的巅峰之作，对后世文学产生了深远影响。曹雪芹本人也因此被后世誉为中国最伟大的小说家之一。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, Cao Xueqin returned to Beijing, continuing to revise and perfect 'Dream of the Red Chamber'. However, due to poverty and deteriorating health, he was unable to complete the last 40 chapters of this masterpiece. It is said that before his death, Cao Xueqin entrusted his manuscripts to friends, but these manuscripts were later lost. Cao Xueqin's death left 'Dream of the Red Chamber' as an unfinished work, which became a great regret in the history of Chinese literature. Nevertheless, the first 80 chapters of 'Dream of the Red Chamber' had already shown extremely high literary value, becoming a pinnacle of Chinese classical fiction and having a profound impact on later literature. Cao Xueqin himself was later hailed as one of the greatest novelists in Chinese history.

supporter.zh: 曹雪芹被誉为中国文学史上最伟大的小说家之一，《红楼梦》被誉为中国古典小说的巅峰之作。他通过细腻的笔触和深刻的思想，展现了封建社会的全貌，塑造了众多栩栩如生的人物形象。曹雪芹的作品不仅具有极高的艺术价值，还蕴含着丰富的人生哲理和对社会现实的批判。他的创作精神和对人性的深刻洞察，使他成为中国文学史上不可逾越的高峰，对后世文学产生了深远影响。
supporter.en: Cao Xueqin is hailed as one of the greatest novelists in Chinese literary history, and 'Dream of the Red Chamber' is considered the pinnacle of Chinese classical fiction. Through his delicate brushwork and profound thoughts, he presented a comprehensive picture of feudal society and created many vivid characters. Cao Xueqin's works not only possess extremely high artistic value but also contain rich philosophical insights and critiques of social reality. His creative spirit and deep insight into human nature make him an insurmountable peak in Chinese literary history, having a profound impact on later literature.

critic.zh: 批评者认为曹雪芹的作品存在一定的局限性，如对封建制度的批判不够彻底，对女性命运的描写过于悲观。此外，《红楼梦》的后四十回由高鹗续写，被认为未能完全体现曹雪芹的原意，影响了作品的完整性。一些学者还指出，曹雪芹虽然对封建社会的腐朽有深刻认识，但未能提出改变社会的有效途径，作品中的消极情绪较为浓厚。这些批评反映了曹雪芹及其作品的某些历史局限性。
critic.en: Critics argue that Cao Xueqin's works have certain limitations, such as insufficient thoroughness in criticizing the feudal system and overly pessimistic portrayals of women's fates. Additionally, the last 40 chapters of 'Dream of the Red Chamber' were completed by Gao E, which is believed to fail to fully reflect Cao Xueqin's original intentions, affecting the completeness of the work. Some scholars also point out that although Cao Xueqin had a deep understanding of the corruption of feudal society, he failed to propose effective ways to change society, and the negative emotions in his works are relatively strong. These criticisms reflect certain historical limitations of Cao Xueqin and his works.

objective.zh: 从客观历史和流行文化视角看，曹雪芹及其作品已成为中国文化的重要符号。《红楼梦》不仅是一部文学巨著，更是研究中国封建社会的重要历史文献。在流行文化中，《红楼梦》被多次改编成影视、戏曲、动漫等多种艺术形式，影响深远。曹雪芹本人也被塑造成一个具有传奇色彩的文化偶像，他的生平故事和创作经历被广泛传颂。在学术界，对曹雪芹及其作品的研究已成为一门专门的学问——'红学'，显示出其在中国文化史上的重要地位。
objective.en: From an objective historical and popular culture perspective, Cao Xueqin and his works have become important symbols of Chinese culture. 'Dream of the Red Chamber' is not only a literary masterpiece but also an important historical document for studying Chinese feudal society. In popular culture, 'Dream of the Red Chamber' has been adapted into various art forms such as film, television, opera, and animation, having a profound impact. Cao Xueqin himself has been shaped into a cultural icon with legendary colors, and his life story and creative experiences are widely celebrated. In academia, the study of Cao Xueqin and his works has become a specialized field known as 'Redology', reflecting his important position in Chinese cultural history.

self.zh: 满纸荒唐言，一把辛酸泪。都云作者痴，谁解其中味？
self.en: All this absurd talk on paper, a handful of bitter tears. All say the author is infatuated, but who understands the true flavor within?

others.zh: 《红楼梦》是一部伟大的社会百科全书，它不仅是中国古典小说的巅峰之作，也是世界文学宝库中的瑰宝。
others.en: 'Dream of the the Red Chamber' is a great social encyclopedia. It is not only the pinnacle of Chinese classical fiction but also a treasure in the world's literary treasure house.
